card.name: Дом заговорщиков
card.description: Раз в ход тайно выберите персонажа для сброса в следующем раунде

userFeedback: Концепт хорош. Однако портрет короля огромный и лежит по центру. Пусть фото императора лежит сбоку маленькой картинкой. Пусть будет не3, а4 заговорщика. Вора мы видим спереди, Лавочника убираем, видим сбоку Патриция, лица немного различимы, но немного, и не всех. По центру у них лежит схема дворца. Перегенерируй с нуля

fromScratchIntent.operation: New generation from scratch with five designated references
fromScratchIntent.intent: Exactly four conspirators, front-facing Thief, profile Patrician, two hidden anonymous faces; central large palace plan, small side Emperor portrait

generation.promptFileTrailingNewline: Saved file has one terminal newline; call prompt otherwise identical

references.role: Primary district full face, parchment, lower ribbon, black Cyrillic serif, purple medallion and painted texture
Exactly six vertical gold coin emblems only; no geometry
Thief identity only: young face, straight dark hair, navy hood and silver forearm guard; front-facing conspirator
Patrician identity only: swept dark hair with grey streak, neat beard, blue/yellow costume, pale collar and red/gold medallion; side/profile conspirator
Emperor identity only for small side portrait: dark skin, short black hair/beard, gold crown, white/gold/red costume

visualChecks.method: Direct visual inspection of tool result and saved PNG via view_image; approximate ratios are visual estimates, not segmentation measurements

frontFacingThief.observed: Front-facing navy hood, head lowered, one eye/part of face under shadow; silver forearm guard; points at palace plan

profilePatrician.observed: Right-side profile, swept hair with grey streak, dark neat beard, blue/yellow garment, pale collar and red/gold pendant

noShopkeeper.observed: No bald elderly spectacled man or Shopkeeper traits

facesInShadow.observed: Anonymous faces fully hidden; Thief face partly hidden under hood; Patrician profile more clearly lit than Thief
facesInShadow.limitation: Patrician has a stronger warm side highlight than the prompt ideal of only faintly distinguishable principal faces

largeCentralPalacePlan.observed: Largest lit central table object, geometric rooms/courtyard/stairs/walls without readable words

smallSideEmperorPortrait.observed: Small painted portrait at right edge of table, separate from the central plan; identifiable crown, dark beard, white/gold/red costume; no words/rank
smallSideEmperorPortrait.sizeEstimate: Roughly 14–15% of full illustration width, larger than the requested 8–10%; area appears roughly <=1/12 of palace plan
smallSideEmperorPortrait.limitation: Side placement and visual subordination achieved; exact miniature width target not met

Patrician profile is more strongly candlelit than the requested faint facial visibility.
Faces and costume details are generative adaptations.
Exact text and coin count checked visually, not by OCR.
Final geometry, lower alignment and JPEG work await artistic approval.
